name: Corteza
description: Low-code platform combining CRM, workflow automation, and messaging for business operations.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_DSN: "postgres://corteza:{{env.DB_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/corteza?sslmode=disable"
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: corteza
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: corteza
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
